identity.name: Master Control Date
identity.one_liner: A three-hand automatic with date, built to Jaeger-LeCoultre's own internal testing standard rather than around a complication.

narrative.story: The Master Control name refers to Jaeger-LeCoultre's own '1000 Hours Control' testing protocol, an internal quality program the manufacture developed to validate finished watches across temperature, position, and power-reserve checks before a case is closed. The Date model carries no complication beyond the date window — it exists to show what a JLC three-hander looks like once the brand's own testing and finishing standard is applied to the simplest possible layout.
narrative.collector_notes: Bracelet and strap options change the perceived value materially on the secondary market; confirm whether a listing includes the steel bracelet, since aftermarket bracelets for this case are not cheap to source separately.
